summary: Visual bug fix verified: on /auth screen, the Populus logo (yellow bilancia) now renders with a BLACK background matching the page's dark theme, fully consistent with the 'schermata login (dopo)' phase 1c mockup. No white square is visible around the logo. Confirmed the Image source in /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx line 167 is 'icon-dark.png' and the loaded URL in the DOM resolves to '.../assets/images/icon-dark.png'. Screenshot at 375x667 mobile viewport shows the logo, 'POPULUS' brand text, tagline and auth tabs all rendering correctly on the dark surface.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: styles.logo has borderRadius: radius.lg without overflow:'hidden'. With icon-dark.png (already dark background) this is imperceptible; can be left as-is.
Non-blocking console warning observed: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — not caused by this fix, but worth cleaning up in a future pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth screen logo fix (icon.png -> icon-dark.png) is verified visually on /auth. DOM confirms src ends with 'icon-dark.png'. No further action needed for this bug.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: previous Image source pointed to icon.png which has the bilancia on a white/light square, creating a visible white block on the dark auth screen. Fix: swapped to icon-dark.png (yellow bilancia on solid black), which now blends into the surface (colors.surface). Verification: DOM inspection of [data-testid="auth-logo"] shows the resolved image URL contains 'icon-dark.png', and the visual screenshot shows no white square around the logo.
